lines.en: label shrine15:
scene shrine_noon
I arrive at the shrine and discover that Maya is nowhere to be seen.
lines.zh: 我来到神社，发现 Maya 不见踪影。

lines.en: That’s come to be expected at this point, though.
lines.zh: 不过到了这一步，这也算是意料之中了。

lines.en: I know she's already denied it but, to be 100%% honest, I wouldn’t be surprised if she was using some sort of weird divine powers to sense my location and hide from me.
lines.zh: 我知道她已经否认过了，但说句百分之百的实话，如果她是在用某种奇怪的神力感知我的位置、然后躲着我，我一点都不会惊讶。

lines.en: Though, I will say...avoidance aside, I have felt at least {i}slightly{/i} closer to her lately.
lines.zh: 不过我得说……抛开躲避不谈，最近我确实觉得和她{i}稍微{/i}亲近了一点。

lines.en: She even lets me in her room now. That must mean something, right?
lines.zh: 她现在甚至肯让我进她的房间了。这总该有点意义吧？

lines.en: Sure, it might be due to the fact that I’ll just bother her even more if she {i}doesn’t{/i} let me in...but what if it's not?
lines.zh: 当然，也许只是因为如果她「不」放我进去，我只会更烦她……可万一{i}不{/i}是呢？

lines.en: What if underneath the miko dress, there's a girl who-
lines.zh: 万一在那身巫女服底下，藏着一个……的女孩——

lines.en: Who-
My thoughts quickly get wrapped up in the image of what is underneath Maya's dress and I forget what I was previously thinking about.
lines.zh: 我的思绪很快就被 Maya 裙子底下的画面缠住了，我忘了自己刚才在想什么。

lines.en: I-
I should probably try and find her...
lines.zh: 我大概该去找找她了……

lines.en: scene black
scene noonsky
: Is...she even here today?
lines.zh: : 她……今天到底在不在啊？

lines.en: I wander the grounds for a good ten minutes without seeing Maya anywhere.
lines.zh: 我在神社境内逛了足足十分钟，哪儿都没看到 Maya。

lines.en: I’m not sure what the schedule for a shrine maiden is like but I'm pretty sure I've heard her say in the past that she's here every weekend.
lines.zh: 我不清楚一名巫女的作息是什么样的，但我很确定以前听她说过，她每个周末都在这儿。

lines.en: I stop and think for a moment that maybe something happened to her.
lines.zh: 我停下脚步，想了一会儿——也许她出了什么事。

lines.en: That maybe someone else got wrapped up in the same thoughts that flooded my head just moments ago.
lines.zh: 也许有别人也陷进了片刻之前充斥我脑海的那些念头里。

lines.en: That someone else {i}was{/i} able to find her...and that they acted on them.
lines.zh: 也许「别人」{i}真的{/i}找到了她……而且付诸了行动。

lines.en: And that there could be some alley not far from here with a torn hakama and the slender body of a servant of {s}God{/s} god pressed up against the wall.
lines.zh: 也许离这儿不远的小巷里，正躺着一条被撕破的袴裙，和一位{s}神{/s}的仆人贴在墙上的纤细身躯。

lines.en: If only I had made it here sooner.
lines.zh: 要是我早点到这儿就好了。

lines.en: scene black
I begin to make my way to the steps of the shrine when the glow of the sun redirects my attention to an area I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: 我开始往神社的台阶走去，这时阳光的反光把我的注意力引向了一个我从没见过的地方。

lines.en: It seems that there is a separate section of the shrine hidden behind a large tree and a few unused donation boxes.
lines.zh: 看起来，神社还有一块被一棵大树和几个闲置的捐献箱遮住的独立区域。

lines.en: I guess one last lap around the grounds wouldn't do any harm.
lines.zh: 我想，再绕境内一圈也没什么坏处。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun1
A normal [teenage]girl stands with her head hung low in the glow of the sun as it bleeds its way through broken tree branches.
lines.zh: 一个普通的[teenage]女孩低着头站在那儿，阳光穿过断裂的树枝渗下来，笼在她身上。

lines.en: It seems she hasn't noticed my presence as of yet.
lines.zh: 她似乎还没有注意到我的存在。

lines.en: And she looks so peaceful and beautiful in this moment that I have second thoughts of disturbing her at all.
lines.zh: 此刻的她看起来那么安详、那么美，我甚至犹豫起要不要打扰她。

lines.en: scene tree3
scene glowofthesun1
But then I remember I need to raise my affection level with her.
lines.zh: 可接着我想起来，我得提升和她的好感度。

lines.en: I remember the sensation of the weakest part of me hardening just moments ago at the thought of what lies underneath that robe.
lines.zh: 我想起就在片刻之前，一想到那件法衣底下藏着什么，我最软弱的那部分就硬了起来。

lines.en: And so I call out, disrupting her midday slumber- killing the peace and beauty along with it.
lines.zh: 于是我开口叫她，打断了她午间的假寐——同时也把那份安详与美一起杀死了。

lines.en: : Ma-
lines.zh: : Ma——

lines.en: : Good afternoon.
lines.zh: : 午安。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun2
: It seems that no place here is truly sacred anymore.
lines.zh: : 看来这地方已经没有一处是真正神圣的了。

lines.en: : And just when I was starting to believe I’d be able to avoid you today.
lines.zh: : 就在我刚开始以为今天能躲开你的时候。

lines.en: : It only took me about fifteen minutes to find. I wouldn't call your mission a complete failure.
lines.zh: : 我找了大概十五分钟而已。我不会说你的任务彻底失败了。

lines.en: : I suppose not. It might not seem like much to you, but fifteen minutes of peace and quiet goes a long way when you're around.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。在你看来也许不算什么，但只要有你在，十五分钟的清静就已经很了不起了。

lines.en: : I did what I could with what little time I had. But I suppose I knew that would come to an end soon enough.
lines.zh: : 我用那点可怜的时间做了我能做的。不过我也知道，那迟早要到头的。

lines.en: : Are you saying you knew I was coming?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你早就知道我会来？

lines.en: scene glowofthesun1
: I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概。

lines.en: : Divine powers again?
lines.zh: : 又是神力？

lines.en: : If only it were that simple.
lines.zh: : 要是真有那么简单就好了。

lines.en: A long silence fills the gap between us.
lines.zh: 一阵长长的沉默填满了我们之间的空隙。

lines.en: I can feel it attempting to force me back toward the stairs I ascended just a short while ago, but I have a hard time tearing myself away from the sight before me.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到它正试图把我推回到不久前才爬上来的那些台阶去，可我很难把视线从眼前的景象上挪开。

lines.en: Bathed in the glow of the sun is a girl staking her case as the most forbidden fruit of all.
lines.zh: 沐浴在阳光里的，是一个正把自己确立为所有禁果之中最禁忌的那一枚的女孩。

lines.en: More forbidden than the one with my blood.
lines.zh: 比我血脉相连的那个更禁忌。

lines.en: scene amiclass
scene glowofthesun1
More forbidden than the one who {i}wishes{/i} for that blood.
lines.zh: 比那个「{i}渴望{/i}」着我血脉的更禁忌。

lines.en: scene ayaneclass
scene glowofthesun1
Before me lies a servant of God who often looks like she'd rather not serve at all.
lines.zh: 我面前站着一位神的仆人，而她常常看起来宁可根本不做这份差事。

lines.en: One who shuns not only Him, but me. A girl who walks her own path despite the many hands that attempt to pull her down others.
lines.zh: 她不仅排斥祂，也排斥我。一个不管有多少只手想把她拽向别的路，都依然走自己路的女孩。

lines.en: I want to pull at her as well.
lines.zh: 我也想拽她。

lines.en: Not just her hair and not just her clothes, but her. Herself. Down a path that I'm afraid of taking on my own.
lines.zh: 不只是拽她的头发，不只是拽她的衣服，而是她。她这个人。拽向一条我自己都不敢独自走上的路。

lines.en: But what I hope to gain from her company is still uncertain to me.
lines.zh: 可我想从她的陪伴里得到什么，我自己也还不确定。

lines.en: What I hope to gain from almost anything is uncertain to me.
lines.zh: 我想从几乎任何东西上得到什么，我都不确定。

lines.en: But what disgusts me the most is that the one thing I {i}am{/i} certain about wanting would leave her a spasming mess on the floor of my bedroom.
lines.zh: 但最让我恶心的{i}是{/i}，我唯一确定自己想要的那件事，会让她在我卧室的地板上抽搐成一团。

lines.en: The fact that I can think that at all in a place like this is proof that God truly is dead.
lines.zh: 我居然能在这种地方产生那种念头，足以证明神真的死了。

lines.en: Either that...or he has simply abandoned us.
lines.zh: 要么……就是祂干脆抛弃了我们。

lines.en: scene mayaclass
scene glowofthesun5
: What do you want? Why are you coming closer?
lines.zh: : 你想干什么？你为什么越靠越近？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: : I just want to, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我只是想这么做，大概。

lines.en: : Ugh...Don’t you have other places to be? Like...literally {i}anywhere{/i} else?
lines.zh: : 唉……你就没有别的地方可去吗？比如……「{i}任何{/i}」别的地方？

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 真没有。

lines.en: : For the love of whoever lives here...stop using your free time on me. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 看在这儿住着的那位的份上……别把你的空闲时间花在我身上了。我是认真的。

lines.en: : There is absolutely nothing good that can come of this.
lines.zh: : 这件事绝不可能有任何好结果。

lines.en: : Nothing at all?
lines.zh: : 一点都没有？

lines.en: scene glowofthesun6
: That's right.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 一点都没有。

lines.en: : You’re close enough to ruin as-is.
lines.zh: : 你已经近到足够把自己毁掉了。

lines.en: : One wrong move or strange circumstance may send you spiraling out of control.
lines.zh: : 一步走错，或者一个奇怪的变故，就可能让你失控地螺旋下坠。

lines.en: : You’ll wind up in a place you’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: : 你会落到一个你从没见过的地方。

lines.en: : And suddenly, you’ll be back at the beginning of everything.
lines.zh: : 然后突然之间，你就回到了一切的起点。

lines.en: : Please avoid this string of unfortunate events by spending your time with other girls.
lines.zh: : 去和别的女孩待在一起，好避开这一连串不幸的事件吧。

lines.en: : I think I’m good. Getting closer to you is my primary objective right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我挺好的。现在我的首要目标就是和你更进一步。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun7
: Tch-!
: Stop...
: Treating this...
lines.zh: : 把这当成……

lines.en: : Like a fucking game.
lines.zh: : 一场他妈的游戏。

lines.en: : I understand how ecstatic you must be to find yourself in a new world surrounded by so many adoring girls...but those girls are {i}people.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道，你发现自己身处一个新世界、身边围着那么多爱慕你的女孩，一定欣喜若狂……可那些女孩是「{i}人{/i}」。

lines.en: : And as much as I hate to admit it, so are you.
lines.zh: : 而尽管我很不愿承认，你也是。

lines.en: : Do not call me an {i}objective.{/i} Not when it lessens the impact of everything I have done so far.
lines.zh: : 别把我说成「{i}目标{/i}」。尤其当你这么做，会让我迄今所做的一切都变得轻飘飘的时候。

lines.en: That’s...an unusual look for her.
lines.zh: 那……对她来说是个不常见的表情。

lines.en: I don't think I've ever seen Maya look genuinely angry before.
lines.zh: 我想我从没见过 Maya 真正生气的样子。

lines.en: Maybe...I {i}am{/i} pushing her a little too far, after all?
lines.zh: 也许……我{i}确实{/i}把她逼得有点太过了？

lines.en: scene glowofthesun8
: Why? Why don’t you ever listen to me?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你为什么从来不听我的？

lines.en: : I...don't really know.
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道。

lines.en: : I swear, this version of you is perhaps the most irritating one yet.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，你这个版本大概是迄今最让人火大的一个。

lines.en: : Perhaps it's not too late to trade it in for a different one.
lines.zh: : 也许现在换个版本还来得及。

lines.en: : I can probably help with that. Do you still have your receipt?
lines.zh: : 我大概能帮忙。你的收据还留着吗？

lines.en: scene glowofthesun9
: Why would I keep a receipt for something I never wanted in the first place?
lines.zh: : 我为什么会留着一件我打从一开始就不想要的东西的收据？

lines.en: : Bookkeeping, maybe? I don't really know how you handle stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 也许是为了记账？我真不知道你平时怎么处理那种事。

lines.en: : Please...just leave this place and carry on with your day. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 拜托……离开这儿，继续过你的一天吧。谢谢。

lines.en: Maybe I should try talking to her in a more...{i}Maya{/i} sort of way?...
lines.zh: 也许我该试着用更……「{i}Maya{/i}」一点的方式跟她说话？……

lines.en: You know. Appeal to her with vague, thought-provoking questions about different kinds of...spiritual or existential ideas or something.
lines.zh: 你知道的。用那些模糊又发人深省的问题打动她，问些关于各种……灵性或者存在主义之类的想法。

lines.en: That might work a little better than just...annoying her until she caves.
lines.zh: 那大概会比……一直烦她直到她让步要好一点。

lines.en: : Hey...
: I said leave.
lines.zh: : 我说了，走。

lines.en: : How do you feel about...fate?
lines.zh: : 你对……命运怎么看？

lines.en: I say the first vague, thought-provoking thing that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 我把脑海里冒出来的第一个模糊又发人深省的东西说了出来。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun10
: What?...
: You know. Fate.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。命运。

lines.en: : Do you have any...thoughts on it or anything?
lines.zh: : 你对此有什么……想法之类的吗？

lines.en: : And...why exactly would you ask me something like that?
lines.zh: : 还有……你到底为什么要问我这个？

lines.en: : Just wondering.
lines.zh: : 只是好奇。

lines.en: : I realize I’ve asked you plenty of questions since showing up here in Kumon-mi...but I thought that maybe I should try asking you something a little different this time.
lines.zh: : 我意识到，自从来到 Kumon-mi 之后，我已经问了你一大堆问题……但我觉得这次也许该问点不一样的。

lines.en: : But why {i}that{/i} question, of all things?
lines.zh: : 可为什么偏偏是「{i}那个{/i}」问题？

lines.en: : No reason, I guess. It just sort of came to me.
lines.zh: : 没什么理由，大概。就是随口冒出来的。

lines.en: : Or maybe it's because I was just {i}fated{/i} to ask you that?
lines.zh: : 或者也许，我只是「{i}命中注定{/i}」要问你这个？

lines.en: : I'm sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: Maya stays quiet for an uncomfortably long time, not reacting to my subpar attempt at a joke.
lines.zh: Maya 沉默了长得让人不适的一段时间，对我这个蹩脚的玩笑毫无反应。

lines.en: I can’t tell if this means I chose the right topic or the wrong topic.
lines.zh: 我说不清这意味着我选对了话题还是选错了话题。

lines.en: She doesn't normally take this long to respond to...anything, though. So I'm beginning to think that-
lines.zh: 不过她平时对「任何事」都不会花这么久才回应。所以我开始觉得——

lines.en: scene glowofthesun11
: I don’t like this question.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个问题。

lines.en: Well...I guess it was the wrong topic after all.
lines.zh: 好吧……看来终究是选错话题了。

lines.en: I’ll just have to think of something else instead.
lines.zh: 我只得再想点别的。

lines.en: I open my mouth, hoping the right words somehow fall out on their own...but before anything falls, she speaks again.
lines.zh: 我张开嘴，盼着合适的词句能自己掉出来……可还没等什么掉出来，她又开口了。

lines.en: : Fate is...well...
lines.zh: : 命运是……嗯……

lines.en: : Inevitable?
lines.zh: : 不可避免的？

lines.en: : There aren't many things I will openly admit to believing in when it comes to the world and all of its many horrible mysteries.
lines.zh: : 关于这个世界以及它那许多可怕的谜团，我愿意公开承认自己相信的东西并不多。

lines.en: : But that...
lines.zh: : 但那……

lines.en: : Actually, no. No, I don’t think {i}belief{/i} has anything to do with it at all.
lines.zh: : 其实不。不，我觉得那跟「{i}信仰{/i}」一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Fate exists. It’s all around us.
lines.zh: : 命运是存在的。它就在我们周围。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun12
: Do you remember my talk about how we all see the same thing as one another, just...filtered through different lenses?
lines.zh: : 你还记得我说过，我们看到的东西彼此相同，只是……透过不同的镜片过滤过吗？

lines.en: : That thing about how we’re all living in some never ending cycle or whatever?
lines.zh: : 就是关于我们都活在某种永无止境的循环里之类的那个？

lines.en: : Yes. That we’ll all wind up in the same place regardless of the decisions we make.
lines.zh: : 记得。就是不管我们做出什么决定，最终都会走到同一个地方。

lines.en: : Do you not see the resemblance this carries to your question?
lines.zh: : 你没看出这和你那个问题有多相似吗？

lines.en: Now that she mentions it, what Maya was talking about back then is essentially the same thing I’m asking her now.
lines.zh: 她这么一说，Maya 当时讲的那套，本质上和我现在问她的是一回事。

lines.en: I didn't mean it like that, though. I didn't put any thought into this question at all.
lines.zh: 不过我不是那个意思。我提这个问题根本没过脑子。

lines.en: It was just a random thought that fell out of my head and into her hands.
lines.zh: 那只是个随机的念头，从我脑袋里掉出来，落进了她的手里。

lines.en: But I’m not sure she realizes that.
lines.zh: 可我不确定她有没有意识到这一点。

lines.en: In her head, she's probably thinking that I’m starting to come around to her unwavering, weird perception of the universe.
lines.zh: 在她脑子里，她大概以为我开始转向她那套顽固又古怪的宇宙观了。

lines.en: : I...remember the talk we had. But what I remember more than that is how you fell asleep sitting up at the end of it.
lines.zh: : 我……记得我们那次谈话。但我记得更清楚的，是那次谈话结束时你是怎么坐着睡着的。

lines.en: : Oh, that? I wasn’t sleeping. I was just waiting for you to leave and {i}pretending{/i} to be sleeping so you would do that.
lines.zh: : 哦，那个？我没睡。我只是在等你走，然后「{i}假装{/i}」睡着，好让你离开。

lines.en: : But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: : 不过那不是重点。

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} not supposed to be asking questions like these. That is my job and you are stealing my personality.
lines.zh: : 「{i}你{/i}」不该问这种问题。那是我的活儿，你在偷我的人设。

lines.en: : It’s disgusting. You should be ashamed. Please stop.
lines.zh: : 真恶心。你该感到羞耻。请停下。

lines.en: : Are you...afraid of being written off or something? Because that's not really my intention here.
lines.zh: : 你是……害怕被一笔勾销之类的吗？因为我真没那个意思。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun13
Maya seems to have a hard time answering the question as she trails off and focuses on a line of ants from one place to the next.
lines.zh: Maya 似乎很难回答这个问题，她声音越来越小，转而盯着一列从一处爬向另一处的蚂蚁。

lines.en: If she {i}is{/i} afraid of being left and that's why she doesn't want to speak up-
lines.zh: 如果她「{i}是{/i}」害怕被丢下，所以才不愿开口——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : That’s not it.
lines.zh: : 不是那样。

lines.en: : I’m just unsure about whether or not you bringing this up has any implications for the immediate future.
lines.zh: : 我只是不确定，你提起这个会不会对不远的将来有什么影响。

lines.en: : What? How would a simple, pointless question like that be able to influence {i}anything{/i} to that extent?
lines.zh: : 什么？一个简单又没意义的问题，怎么可能影响「{i}任何事{/i}」到那个程度？

lines.en: : Don't call it simple...and don't call it pointless. I don't want to hear that.
lines.zh: : 别叫它简单……也别叫它没意义。我不想听这种话。

lines.en: : What matters most is that this is a deviation from the way things are supposed to work.
lines.zh: : 最重要的是，这偏离了事情本该运转的方式。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} don't ask me questions like this. You just try to get me to like you and fail miserably.
lines.zh: : 「{i}你{/i}」不会问我这种问题。你只是一直想让我喜欢你，然后惨败。

lines.en: : Well, would you prefer I just continue flirting with you instead?
lines.zh: : 那么，你更希望我继续跟你调情？

lines.en: : I don't really know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: She pauses once more.
lines.zh: 她又停顿了一次。

lines.en: For a moment, I think I catch a glimpse of her lower lip trembling. But before I'm able to confirm anything, she speaks again.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间，我觉得自己瞥见她的下唇在颤抖。可我还没来得及确认，她又开口了。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun14
: You’re changing.
lines.zh: : 你在变。

lines.en: : ...What?
: You’re changing.
lines.zh: : 你在变。

lines.en: : In...a good way? Or a bad way?
lines.zh: : 是……往好的方向？还是坏的方向？

lines.en: : A way.
lines.zh: : 往某个方向。

lines.en: : So...can I take this as confirmation that you’re beginning to like me?
lines.zh: : 那么……我可以把这当成你开始喜欢我的确认吗？

lines.en: : Is that really what you’re concerned about right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在真正在意的就只有这个吗？

lines.en: : Aren’t there more pressing matters at hand?
lines.zh: : 就没有更紧要的事了吗？

lines.en: : More pressing than the affection of a cute shrine maiden? I doubt it.
lines.zh: : 比一位可爱巫女的好感更紧要？我怀疑。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun14r
: Hah...Maybe I spoke too soon...
lines.zh: : 哈……也许我说得太早了……

lines.en: : Maybe you aren’t changing after all.
lines.zh: : 也许你根本没在变。

lines.en: : Yes...That has to be it.
lines.zh: : 是啊……一定是这样。

lines.en: : This was simply a fluke.
lines.zh: : 这只是一次偶然。

lines.en: : An accidental deviation with no real meaning to it.
lines.zh: : 一次没有真正意义的意外偏差。

lines.en: : Exactly. Like I said, I was just trying to say something that you-
lines.zh: : 没错。就像我说的，我只是想说点让你——

lines.en: : Hey, wait a minute. Why do I feel like what you just said was kind of insulting?
lines.zh: : 嘿，等等。为什么我觉得你刚才说的那句话有点侮辱人？

lines.en: : I don't know. You started talking on your own without letting me finish.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。是你自己先开口的，都没让我说完。

lines.en: : Well, what more did you have to say?
lines.zh: : 那你还想说什么？

lines.en: : Not much.
lines.zh: : 不多了。

lines.en: scene glowofthesun15
: Just that everything is connected.
lines.zh: : 只是想说，一切都是相连的。

lines.en: : Life and death...
lines.zh: : 生与死……

lines.en: : Day and night...
lines.zh: : 昼与夜……

lines.en: : Summer and winter...
lines.zh: : 夏与冬……

lines.en: : You and me?
lines.zh: : 你和我？

lines.en: I half-expect Maya to greet me with her token deadpan glare after that line but, instead...she focuses on the clouds passing overhead and lets out a sigh.
lines.zh: 说完那句之后，我本以为 Maya 会用她标志性的白眼瞪我，可她……却盯着头顶飘过的云，叹了口气。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You and me...
lines.zh: : 你和我……

lines.en: scene black
The clouds Maya was focusing on passed over the sun seconds later, blacking out the glow that had been dyeing her dress gold.
lines.zh: 几秒后，Maya 一直盯着的那片云遮住了太阳，熄灭了那把她的法衣染成金色的光。

lines.en: The conversation did not pick up again after that.
lines.zh: 在那之后，对话再没有继续。

lines.en: She just kept looking up-
lines.zh: 她只是一直抬头看着——

lines.en: Even after the light had gone away.
lines.zh: 即使光已经消失了。

lines.en: I left her in her secret hiding place and walked away from the shrine.
lines.zh: 我把她留在了她的秘密藏身处，走出了神社。

lines.en: I'm not sure how long it took for her to notice.
lines.zh: 我不确定她过了多久才注意到。

lines.en: $ shrine15 = True
$ maya_love += 1
$ connect = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
